datasets.name: dep_tickers
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
, t AS (SELECT sum(f.balance_vnd) AS bal,
               CASE WHEN bool_and(f.monthly_avg_complete)
                    THEN sum(f.monthly_avg_balance_vnd) END AS mavg
        FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_trend f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d WHERE (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch)),
c AS (SELECT sum(f.retail_customers) AS retail
      FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_casa_customer f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d WHERE (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch))
SELECT cur.d AS report_date, t.bal / cur.usd / 1000 AS ending_balance, t.mavg / cur.usd / 1000 AS monthly_avg_balance,
       c.retail AS retail_customers
FROM cur CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN c

datasets.name: dep_compare
datasets.displayName: Tickers vs last day / month / year
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
, t AS (SELECT sum(f.diff_d1) AS b1, sum(f.diff_m1) AS b2, sum(f.diff_y1) AS b3,
               CASE WHEN bool_and(f.monthly_avg_complete)
                    THEN sum(f.monthly_avg_balance_vnd) END AS a0,
               sum(f.monthly_avg_balance_d1) AS a1, sum(f.monthly_avg_balance_m1) AS a2,
               sum(f.monthly_avg_balance_y1) AS a3
        FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_trend f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d WHERE (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch)),
per AS (SELECT stack(3, 1, 'vs Last Day', previous_date, 2, 'vs Last Month',
                     previous_month_date, 3, 'vs Last Year', previous_year_date)
               AS (ord, cmp, dd) FROM cur),
cc AS (SELECT f.as_of_date, sum(f.retail_customers) AS r FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_casa_customer f
       WHERE f.as_of_date IN (SELECT d FROM cur UNION ALL SELECT dd FROM per) AND (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch)
       GROUP BY f.as_of_date)
SELECT per.ord, concat(per.cmp, ' (', coalesce(date_format(per.dd, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'N/A'), ')')
           AS compare,
       round(CASE per.ord WHEN 1 THEN t.b1 WHEN 2 THEN t.b2 ELSE t.b3 END / cur.usd / 1000, 0)
           AS ending_balance,
       round((t.a0 - CASE per.ord WHEN 1 THEN t.a1 WHEN 2 THEN t.a2 ELSE t.a3 END) / cur.usd / 1000, 0)
           AS monthly_avg_balance,
       c0.r - cp.r AS retail_customers
FROM per CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN cur
LEFT JOIN cc c0 ON c0.as_of_date = cur.d LEFT JOIN cc cp ON cp.as_of_date = per.dd
ORDER BY per.ord

datasets.name: dep_gauges
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
, g AS (SELECT sum(f.diff_y1) AS all_g,
               sum(CASE WHEN f.group_class = '1-CASA' THEN f.diff_y1 END) AS casa_g,
               sum(CASE WHEN f.group_class IN ('2-TD', '3-ISA') THEN f.diff_y1 END) AS tda_g
        FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_trend f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d WHERE (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch)),
tg AS (
  SELECT sum(CASE WHEN f.metric_code = 'DEPOSIT_GROWTH_ALL' THEN f.target_value END) AS all_t,
         sum(CASE WHEN f.metric_code = 'DEPOSIT_GROWTH_CASA' THEN f.target_value END) AS casa_t,
         sum(CASE WHEN f.metric_code = 'DEPOSIT_GROWTH_TD_ISA' THEN f.target_value END)
             AS tda_t
  FROM (SELECT t.*, b.region FROM silver.ref_targets t
        LEFT JOIN gold_serving.dim_branch b ON b.branchnbr = t.branchnbr) f CROSS JOIN cur
  WHERE f.period_type = 'YEAR' AND f.period = CAST(year(cur.d) AS STRING) AND (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch))
SELECT g.all_g / nullif(tg.all_t, 0) * 100 AS all_pct,
       g.casa_g / nullif(tg.casa_t, 0) * 100 AS casa_pct,
       g.tda_g / nullif(tg.tda_t, 0) * 100 AS tda_pct
FROM g CROSS JOIN tg

datasets.name: dep_daily30
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
SELECT date_format(f.as_of_date, 'MM-dd') AS day, f.as_of_date,
       sum(f.balance_vnd) / cur.usd / 1000 AS balance
FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_trend f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date BETWEEN date_sub(cur.d, 29) AND cur.d
WHERE (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch) AND (:product = 'all' OR f.group_class = :product)
GROUP BY f.as_of_date, cur.usd ORDER BY f.as_of_date

datasets.name: dep_monthly
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
SELECT date_format(to_date(concat(f.month_id, '-01')), 'MMM') AS month,
       concat(f.group_class, CASE WHEN substr(f.month_id, 1, 4) = CAST(year(cur.d) AS STRING)
                                  THEN ' this year' ELSE ' last year' END) AS series,
       sum(f.ending_balance_vnd) / cur.usd / 1000 AS ending_balance
FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_monthly f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d
WHERE (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch)
GROUP BY f.month_id, f.group_class, cur.d, cur.usd

datasets.name: dep_term
datasets.displayName: Deposit by Term and IR (in Month)
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
SELECT f.tenor_bucket AS tenor, min(f.tenor_sort_order) AS sort_order,
       sum(f.balance_vnd) / cur.usd / 1000 AS balance,
       sum(f.interest_weighted_numerator) / nullif(sum(f.interest_weighted_denominator), 0)
           * 100 AS avg_interest
FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_by_tenor f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d
WHERE (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch)
GROUP BY f.tenor_bucket, cur.usd ORDER BY sort_order

datasets.name: dep_casa_customer
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x

               sum(f.casa_dormant_customers) AS dormant

UNION ALL SELECT 'Active', active FROM c

datasets.name: dep_edusave
datasets.displayName: Edu-Save New open Account_ Accumulate by Month
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
, n AS (SELECT f.open_month, sum(f.new_accounts) AS n FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_new_accounts f JOIN cur
        ON f.as_of_date = cur.d
        WHERE f.product_type = 'EDUSAVE' AND (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch) GROUP BY f.open_month)
SELECT concat(CAST(year(cur.d) - 1 AS STRING), ' Total') AS month,
       sum(n.n) AS cumulative_accounts
FROM n CROSS JOIN cur WHERE substr(n.open_month, 1, 4) = CAST(year(cur.d) - 1 AS STRING)
GROUP BY cur.d
UNION ALL
SELECT n.open_month, sum(n.n) OVER (ORDER BY n.open_month) FROM n CROSS JOIN cur
WHERE substr(n.open_month, 1, 4) = CAST(year(cur.d) AS STRING)

datasets.name: dep_by_product
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
, r AS (SELECT f.group_class, f.account_group, sum(f.balance_vnd) AS bal,
               sum(f.diff_d1) AS d1, sum(f.diff_m1) AS m1, sum(f.diff_y1) AS y1,
               grouping(f.group_class) AS g_class, grouping(f.account_group) AS g_group
        FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_trend f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d
        WHERE (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch) AND (:currency = 'all' OR f.currencycd = :currency)
          AND (:nationality = 'all' OR f.nationality = :nationality)
        GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((f.group_class, f.account_group), (f.group_class), ()))
SELECT CASE WHEN r.g_class = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' WHEN r.g_group = 1 THEN r.group_class
            ELSE concat('    ', r.account_group) END AS product,
       CASE WHEN r.g_class = 1 THEN 0 WHEN r.g_group = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS level,
       round(r.bal / cur.usd / 1000, 0) AS ending_balance,
       round(r.bal / nullif(max(CASE WHEN r.g_class = 1 THEN r.bal END) OVER (), 0) * 100, 1)
           AS portion,
       round(r.d1 / cur.usd / 1000, 0) AS diff_last_day, round(r.m1 / cur.usd / 1000, 0) AS diff_last_month,
       round(r.y1 / cur.usd / 1000, 0) AS diff_last_year
FROM r CROSS JOIN cur
ORDER BY r.g_class, r.group_class, r.g_group DESC, r.account_group

datasets.name: dep_kpi_cards
queryLines:
SELECT stack(3,
  CAST('ending_balance' AS STRING), CAST('Ending Balance' AS STRING), CAST(k.ending_balance AS DOUBLE), CAST(',.0f' AS STRING), CAST(c.ending_balance_1 AS DOUBLE), CAST('Last Day' AS STRING), CAST(c.ending_balance_2 AS DOUBLE), CAST('Last Month' AS STRING), CAST(c.ending_balance_3 AS DOUBLE), CAST('Last Year' AS STRING), CAST('' AS STRING), CAST(',.0f' AS STRING), CAST('Unit: USD 1,000' AS STRING), CAST(concat('Report date ', date_format(k.report_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS STRING),
  CAST('monthly_avg_balance' AS STRING), CAST('Monthly Avg Balance' AS STRING), CAST(k.monthly_avg_balance AS DOUBLE), CAST(',.0f' AS STRING), CAST(c.monthly_avg_balance_1 AS DOUBLE), CAST('Last Day' AS STRING), CAST(c.monthly_avg_balance_2 AS DOUBLE), CAST('Last Month' AS STRING), CAST(c.monthly_avg_balance_3 AS DOUBLE), CAST('Last Year' AS STRING), CAST('' AS STRING), CAST(',.0f' AS STRING), CAST('Unit: USD 1,000' AS STRING), CAST(concat('Report date ', date_format(k.report_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS STRING),
  CAST('retail_customers' AS STRING), CAST('Retail Customers' AS STRING), CAST(k.retail_customers AS DOUBLE), CAST(',.0f' AS STRING), CAST(c.retail_customers_1 AS DOUBLE), CAST('Last Day' AS STRING), CAST(c.retail_customers_2 AS DOUBLE), CAST('Last Month' AS STRING), CAST(c.retail_customers_3 AS DOUBLE), CAST('Last Year' AS STRING), CAST('' AS STRING), CAST(',.0f' AS STRING), CAST('Customers' AS STRING), CAST(concat('Report date ', date_format(k.report_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS STRING)
) AS (kpi, title, value, value_fmt, cmp1, cmp1_label, cmp2, cmp2_label, cmp3, cmp3_label, cmp_unit, cmp_fmt, note1, note2)
FROM (WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
, t AS (SELECT sum(f.balance_vnd) AS bal,
               CASE WHEN bool_and(f.monthly_avg_complete)
                    THEN sum(f.monthly_avg_balance_vnd) END AS mavg
        FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_trend f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d WHERE (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch)),
c AS (SELECT sum(f.retail_customers) AS retail
      FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_casa_customer f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d WHERE (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch))
SELECT cur.d AS report_date, t.bal / cur.usd / 1000 AS ending_balance, t.mavg / cur.usd / 1000 AS monthly_avg_balance,
       c.retail AS retail_customers
FROM cur CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN c) k CROSS JOIN (SELECT max(CASE WHEN ord = 1 THEN ending_balance END) AS ending_balance_1, max(CASE WHEN ord = 2 THEN ending_balance END) AS ending_balance_2, max(CASE WHEN ord = 3 THEN ending_balance END) AS ending_balance_3, max(CASE WHEN ord = 1 THEN monthly_avg_balance END) AS monthly_avg_balance_1, max(CASE WHEN ord = 2 THEN monthly_avg_balance END) AS monthly_avg_balance_2, max(CASE WHEN ord = 3 THEN monthly_avg_balance END) AS monthly_avg_balance_3, max(CASE WHEN ord = 1 THEN retail_customers END) AS retail_customers_1, max(CASE WHEN ord = 2 THEN retail_customers END) AS retail_customers_2, max(CASE WHEN ord = 3 THEN retail_customers END) AS retail_customers_3 FROM (
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date, c.previous_year_date,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.deposit_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
, t AS (SELECT sum(f.diff_d1) AS b1, sum(f.diff_m1) AS b2, sum(f.diff_y1) AS b3,
               CASE WHEN bool_and(f.monthly_avg_complete)
                    THEN sum(f.monthly_avg_balance_vnd) END AS a0,
               sum(f.monthly_avg_balance_d1) AS a1, sum(f.monthly_avg_balance_m1) AS a2,
               sum(f.monthly_avg_balance_y1) AS a3
        FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_trend f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d WHERE (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch)),
per AS (SELECT stack(3, 1, 'vs Last Day', previous_date, 2, 'vs Last Month',
                     previous_month_date, 3, 'vs Last Year', previous_year_date)
               AS (ord, cmp, dd) FROM cur),
cc AS (SELECT f.as_of_date, sum(f.retail_customers) AS r FROM gold_serving.dep_mart_casa_customer f
       WHERE f.as_of_date IN (SELECT d FROM cur UNION ALL SELECT dd FROM per) AND (:region = 'all' OR f.region = :region) AND (:branch = 'all' OR f.branchnbr = :branch)
       GROUP BY f.as_of_date)
SELECT per.ord, concat(per.cmp, ' (', coalesce(date_format(per.dd, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'N/A'), ')')
           AS compare,
       round(CASE per.ord WHEN 1 THEN t.b1 WHEN 2 THEN t.b2 ELSE t.b3 END / cur.usd / 1000, 0)
           AS ending_balance,
       round((t.a0 - CASE per.ord WHEN 1 THEN t.a1 WHEN 2 THEN t.a2 ELSE t.a3 END) / cur.usd / 1000, 0)
           AS monthly_avg_balance,
       c0.r - cp.r AS retail_customers
FROM per CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN cur
LEFT JOIN cc c0 ON c0.as_of_date = cur.d LEFT JOIN cc cp ON cp.as_of_date = per.dd
ORDER BY per.ord)) c
